summary: One-frame event of esv::inventory::InteractionSystem, born when an item leaves an inventory (equipment changes, dropping the dagger in shove-throw, deaths, scripted events). Its twin esv::inventory::MemberAddedEventOneFrameComponent is a tag. Registered with size 0x10 and no destructor (bg3.exe+0x348DE90). Readers: esv::hotbar::System (remove-slot requests), esv::status::recovery::RecoverySystem, esv::camp::SupplySystem (queried with MemberAdded and StackEntityAmountChanged).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Live: entity handles (0x0180000100000A38 ... 0x0200000900021CB6) in all 28 instances; probably the inventory the member left (the component sits on the member). Not established from code.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Live: byte 0 or 1; the following bytes are 00 or FF leftovers -> one byte (a flag) followed by padding.

fields.evidence: live bytes vary between 00 and FF/garbage (one-frame storage is not cleared) -> padding.

open_questions: Which entity +0 is (inventory / container owner); meaning of the flag at +8; the writer in InteractionSystem was not found.
status_reason: the author's confidence is low: types fit the live data, meanings are not established
second_pass: Size confirmed only: bg3.exe+0x348DE90 registers the one-frame storage with element size 0x10; the reader in the hotbar system (bg3.exe+0x2DA83E0, ~ esv::hotbar::System::ProcessRemoveSlotRequests) was opened but the member reads were not isolated, so the members stay hypotheses.
